notes.subject: verse order
notes.rationale: MT numbering places this verse as 21:26; KJV/English editions shift verses 21-26 — here the Hebrew given follows JPS/MT order.

notes.subject: to the sword of Babylon
notes.rationale: feminine singular imperatives address the sword itself, commanded to choose its path.

notes.subject: addressed to the sword
notes.rationale: Most renderings keep the address to the sword; some read the verse as Yawe mocking the diviner's random choice — right or left, both lead where Yawe decreed.

translation: Aw ye aw lamini: bila aw yɛrɛ bolo-numan-fɛ walima aw yɛrɛ bila bolo-habe-fɛ; i ka ɲɛda datugunen don yɔrɔ min na?
